replies.body: Maybe it would be better to merge this PR using a temporary name. Could add `experimental` suffix/prefix  or maybe even something like `dontuse` to indicate that it is subjected to change. This could let us avoid potential conflict resolution.
Update: I'm trying to get this supported under the `.general` node by the next SDK release
Update: this will be available in the upcoming SDK release
